verdict.rationale: Ollama's download page documents a one-line install script (`curl -fsSL https://ollama.com/install.sh | sh`), so installation does not require compiling from source. Community reports add downloadable macOS and Windows apps and shipped ROCm containers. However, the first-party evidence never explicitly states that prebuilt binaries are provided, and native installers and containers are evidenced only by community comments. missing for 10: first-party documentation of prebuilt binaries/packages per OS (macOS/Windows installers, Linux packages), official container image documentation, and a statement of which platforms and architectures are covered.

support.subject: As a developer, I can install using prebuilt binaries or packages instead of compiling from source

citations.quote: Ollama's new app is now available for macOS and Windows
They have shipped ROCm containers since 0.1.27.
